1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa “Amarebe”. Ni Zaburi ya bene Kōra yahimbishijwe ubwenge. Ni indirimbo y'urukundo.

2.text: Umutima wanjye urabize usesekara ibyiza,Ndavuga indirimbo nahimbiye umwami,Ururimi rwanjye ni ikaramu y'uwandika vuba.

3.text: Uruta ubwiza abana b'abantu,Ubukundiriza busutswe ku minwa yawe,Ni cyo gitumye Imana iguha umugisha w'iteka.

4.text: Wa ntwari we, ambara inkota yawe ku itako,Ambara ubwiza bwawe n'icyubahiro cyawe.

5.text: Ugendane icyubahiro uri ku ifarashi uneshe,Urengere ukuri n'ubugwaneza no gukiranuka,Ukuboko kwawe kw'iburyo kukwigishe ibitera ubwoba.

6.text: Imyambi yawe iratyaye,Amahanga agwa hasi imbere yawe,Imyambi yawe iri mu mitima y'ababisha b'umwami.

7.text: Mana, intebe yawe ni iy'iteka ryose,Inkoni y'ubugabe bwawe ni inkoni y'utwara agororoka.

8.text: Wakunze gukiranuka wanga ibyaha,Ni cyo cyatumye Imana ari yo Mana yawe,Igusīga amavuta yo kwishima,Kukurutisha bagenzi bawe.

9.text: Imyenda yawe yose ihumura ishangi n'umusaga na kesīya,Inanga zo mu mazu yubakishijwe amahembe y'inzovu zirakwishimishije.

10.text: Mu bagore bawe b'icyubahiro harimo abakobwa b'abami,Iburyo bwawe hahagaze umwamikazi yambaye izahabu yavuye Ofiri.

11.text: Umva mukobwa, utekereze utege ugutwi,Kandi wibagirwe ishyanga ryanyu n'inzu ya so.

12.text: Ni cyo kizatuma umwami akunda ubwiza bwawe,Kuko ari we mwami wawe nawe umuramye.

13.text: Kandi umukobwa w'i Tiro azazana impano,Kandi abatunzi bo mu bantu bazagusaba kubahakirwa.

14.text: Umukobwa w'umwami uri mu kirambi afite ubwiza bwinshi,Imyenda ye iboheshejwe izahabu.

15.text: Ari buzanirwe umwami yambaye imyenda idaraje,Abakobwa bagenzi be bamukurikiye,Bari buzanwe aho uri.

16.text: Bari buzanishwe umunezero n'ibyishimo,Binjire mu nzu y'umwami.

17.text: Mwami, mu cyimbo cya ba sogokuruza bawe,Kizasubiramo abana bawe,Ni bo uzagira abatware mu isi yose.

18.text: Nzibukiriza izina ryawe ibihe byose,Ni cyo gituma amahanga azagushima iteka ryose.
